summary.text: Christopher Monday is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 6th District, a seat he has sought before. He is running on defending individual liberties and reducing spending.

paragraphs.text: Monday was born on the Naval base in Charleston, South Carolina, according to his Ballotpedia survey. He has cerebral palsy. He says he graduated from high school with honors at Cookeville High School and attended Tennessee Technological University for two years without finishing.
In 2018 he told a news outlet that he was running for the 6th District seat as a Republican, with the goal of returning the country to the Constitution.
Monday ran as an independent in the November 3, 2020 general election for the 6th District, which incumbent John Rose won.

sources.title: Tennessee man isn't letting cerebral palsy stand in way of run for Congress
